Select approved drugs with mechanism action_type 'PARTIAL AGONIST'. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_mechanism on molregno. Join to target_dictionary on tid to retrieve target identifiers and names. Join to compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical SMILES. Filter for max_phase = 4. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id, and target_name. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id, and target_name.
